name: ComboboxInputGroup
description: Combines `Combobox.InputGroupPrimitive`, `Combobox.InputPrimitive`, `Combobox.ClearPrimitive`, and `Combobox.TriggerPrimitive` into a single part. Use the primitives to change what it holds. Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: children
props.description: Not rendered: the group always holds the input, clear button, and trigger. Use `Combobox.InputGroupPrimitive` to compose custom content.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: Combobox.InputGroup.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
